method: Read-only stdlib/AST inspection only. The helper, repair mechanism, and referenced base-hash contract were read; no helper, model, generator, product, test, Git, or network operation was run.

blockers.finding: The uniqueness guard uses str.count(old) == 1, but str.count counts non-overlapping matches. A literal old string can occur twice with overlap and still pass. For example, old='aa' in a current string containing 'aaa' returns count 1 although matches begin at offsets 0 and 1; replace(old, new, 1) then silently selects the first ambiguous occurrence. The R2 mechanism requires old to occur exactly once after each preceding edit, so this can apply a non-unique patch.
blockers.minimal_repair: Replace the count check with an overlapping occurrence check: find the first index, then search from first_index + 1 (or equivalent startswith scan), and require exactly one start position before replace. Preserve sequential edits and the existing literal replacement behavior.

external_obligations_not_reaudited: later independent generator review and resource acceptance
repair_recommendation: Correct the overlapping-match guard, then repeat this bounded static review against the revised helper. No other helper blocker was found in this pass.
